title: [aarch64] Reduce CUDA SBSA Wheel Size
bug_description:
### 🚀 The feature, motivation and pitch

Currently the CUDA SBSA wheel is using the big wheel approach while bundling all the libs into final wheel, size is around 3GB for 2.9.0 nightly, so we would want to switch to small wheel like pulling from pypi index.
